- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ideal humidity level for fermenting pizza dough is between 60% and 70%.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for controlling temperature and humidity include using a thermometer and hygrometer, fermenting in a draft-free area, covering the dough, and considering a proofing box.
